activities.name: Persist
activities.description: Reserved memory persistence activity; its current branch has no implementation.

coverage.notes: Reserved branch has only break, but the shared post-dispatch ReturnItemSignal read still executes. It is not a zero-read activity.

properties.description: Return ItemSignal after the reserved Persist branch when requested.

evidence.trace: Shared trailing resolver reads original Plan.ReturnItemSignal with literal -Default $false.
evidence.condition: Persist after its reserved branch.

coverage.notes: GetNextStep receives original Plan as phase; Steps elements are selected then cloned before execution. Steps.* denotes fixed members of those incoming elements. Preserve original-element provenance only until hydration replaces a step or local writes replace a member; those generated values and downstream named-adapter reads are not additional incoming properties. Branch failure/early returns may skip trailing ReturnItemSignal.

properties.description: Return ItemSignal after generating all steps when requested.

evidence.trace: Shared trailing resolver reads original Plan.ReturnItemSignal with literal -Default $false.
evidence.condition: Generate only when execution reaches the trailing resolver without returning early.

properties.description: Enumerate phase steps for execution and step-to-step navigation.

evidence.trace: GetNextStep parameter phase aliases original Plan. Its Steps collection supplies the step objects cloned for execution; fixed child-member reads are documented separately.
evidence.condition: Generate whenever selecting the first or a subsequent step.

properties.description: Identify step tracing and select the dispatched activity or Goto control flow.

evidence.trace: Original Plan aliases phase; phase.Steps supplies each selected step. The fixed member Activity is read directly or by resolver on that step. Config.SkipSteps uses ?? 0, not a supplied resolver Default. Config is forwarded only during deferred hydration.
